inline-settings.center-workflow-description: Click the root menu center to run these actions in order.
inline-settings.restored: Restored to the editor. Save to apply.

native.action-value: Shortcut, path, URL, text, or JSON
native.condition-invalid: Enter a valid window or app condition, for example /notepad/i.
native.icon-invalid-image: Choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, or ICO image up to 192 KB.
native.imported: Imported {0} menu(s). Review imported commands before using them, then save.
native.label: Label
native.name: Menu name
native.shortcut-config-changed: The menu configuration changed on disk. Save the current menus to apply this shortcut.
native.shortcut-in-use: Windows reports that this shortcut is already in use.
native.shortcut-invalid: Enter one key, plus any modifiers allowed for this shortcut.
native.shortcut-save-new-menu: Save this new menu to activate its shortcut.
native.shortcut-saved: Shortcut saved: {0}. Use it to open the menu when Quick Actions is enabled.
native.shortcut-unavailable: Windows could not register this shortcut.

general-settings-dialog.enable-marking-mode-info: With Marking Mode enabled, you can select items by dragging the mouse over them.
general-settings-dialog.enable-turbo-mode-info: With Turbo Mode enabled, you can perform gestures as long as you hold down a modifier key such as Shift or Ctrl.
general-settings-dialog.middle-mouse-button-behavior-info: This determines what happens when the middle mouse button is pressed while a menu is shown.
general-settings-dialog.move-pointer-to-menu-center: Move pointer to the menu center
general-settings-dialog.move-pointer-to-menu-center-info: If checked, the mouse pointer will be moved to the center of a menu or submenu when necessary. This could be the case if a menu is opened too close to the edge of the screen or if a menu is opened in Centered Mode.
general-settings-dialog.require-click-for-hover-mode: Require click for Hover Mode selections
general-settings-dialog.require-click-for-hover-mode-info: If unchecked, items will be selected immediately when the mouse is moved over them for menus using Hover Mode.
general-settings-dialog.right-mouse-button-behavior-info: This determines what happens when the right mouse button is pressed while a menu is shown.
general-settings-dialog.trigger-center-click-on-key-release: Close menu on shortcut release over center
general-settings-dialog.trigger-center-click-on-key-release-info: This will trigger the center-click workflow when a key is released while hovering over the center of a menu.

settings.shortcut-info: This shortcut opens the menu. It must contain one normal key and any number of modifiers such as Ctrl, Alt, or Shift. When recording, you do not have to press all keys at once, you can also press them one after another. This is useful if a shortcut is already bound to another menu!
settings.anchored-mode-info: Open submenus at the same position as the parent menu. Checking this, will disable Marking Mode and Turbo Mode.
settings.fixed-position-mode-info: Open the menu at a fixed position on the screen, instead of at the cursor.
settings.hover-mode-info: For power users only! Select items by hovering over them.
